## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
You need to fix one Important project-policy issue: the new `--exclude` flag does not take its default from an `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` environment variable, as the cli-flags rule requires for every new flag under `cli/`.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option. `collect()` uses it to skip files whose basename matches any of the patterns and logs each skipped path. The change also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds parser, collection and end-to-end archive tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Seed `--exclude` default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — If CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and does not pass the flag, `.log` files are still archived, because the default is a hard-coded `[]`. `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines that set options through the environment cannot exclude files, so the archive can contain files they meant to leave out. — Fix: Build the default list by splitting `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` on a documented separator, add the variable to `docs/flags.md`, and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover the environment value.
